name: Action inputs
description: Make the inputs the action was run with readable as {{inputs.name}}.

name: Evaluate a decision table
description: Apply a table of rules to each item and write the outcome onto it.

returned.label: Decision table
returned.help: The table as JSON: hit policy, inputs, outputs and rules. Saving refuses a table the engine cannot run. Leave empty to use a stored table.

returned.label: Stored decision table
returned.help: A table from the decision-tables register. Use this or an inline table, not both.

returned.label: Input fields
returned.help: Where each table input is read from, as input name to field path. An input without an entry reads the field with its own name.

returned.label: Output fields
returned.help: Where each table output is written, as output name to field path. An output without an entry writes the field with its own name.

returned.label: When no rule matches
returned.help: Values to write when no rule matches, one per output. Leave empty to fail the step instead.

returned.label: Record the evaluation under
returned.help: Optional field path for the evaluation record: which rules matched and under which hit policy.

name: End
description: End the flow here, optionally as an error with a message.

returned.label: End the run as failed
returned.help: Failing is an outcome, not the absence of one: leave this off for an ending the flow expects.

returned.label: Message
returned.help: Written to the run log as the reason the run ended here.

returned.label: Afterwards, go to
returned.help: Overrides the manual trigger's choice for a run that ends here: "stay", "next" or "list". Empty keeps the trigger's choice.

name: Explode
description: Turn a list on the item into one item per entry, so later steps act on each.

returned.label: List field
returned.help: The field on each item that holds a list, like "findings". Every element becomes an item of its own.

returned.label: Name each element
returned.help: The field each new item carries its element under. Defaults to "item".

returned.label: Keep the rest of the item
returned.help: On by default: each new item also carries the fields of the item it came from.

name: Repeat until done
description: Run a chain of steps once per batch, until the source runs out.

returned.label: At most this many passes
returned.help: A loop that never runs dry repeats its side effects until something stops it; this is that something. Defaults to 100. The batch source and the steps to repeat are edited in the JSON pane.

returned.label: When the limit is reached
returned.help: "fail" (the default) ends the run as failed; "stop" ends the loop and carries on with what it collected.

name: Merge
description: Combine the items arriving from several branches into one list.

returned.label: How to combine
returned.help: "append" keeps every item in branch order (the default), "mergeByKey" joins the items that share a key into one, "unique" keeps only the first item per key.

returned.label: Key field
returned.help: The field items are matched on. Needed for "mergeByKey" and "unique"; when two branches set the same field, the later branch wins.
